exercises.question: Which sentence contains a quantity comparison? [¿Cuál contiene una comparación de cantidad?]
options: Tengo menos gastos este mes que el mes pasado. [I have fewer expenses this month than last month.]
Tengo gastos este mes. [I have expenses this month.]
Tengo un presupuesto. [I have a budget.]

exercises.sentence: El coste aumenta __ faltan materiales. (porque) [The cost increases because materials are lacking.]

exercises.english: If I had more money, I would invest part of it.

sentences: Los precios han subido este año. [Prices have risen this year.]
Hay poca oferta; por eso, el precio aumenta. [There is little supply; therefore, the price increases.]
Como consecuencia, algunas familias gastan menos. [As a consequence, some families spend less.]

exercises.question: Which expression introduces a hypothetical condition? [¿Cuál introduce una condición hipotética?]
options: si tuviera [if I had]
por eso [therefore]
se observa que [it can be observed that]

exercises.sentence: No __ todos mis ahorros. (arriesgaría) [I would not risk all my savings.]

exercises.english: It seems the economy is improving.

exercises.question: Which form completes «Es posible»? [Which form completes the sentence?]
options: Si tuviera más dinero, invertiría una parte. [If I had more money, I would invest part of it.]
Si tengo más dinero, invertiría una parte. [If I have more money, I would invest part of it.]
Si tendría más dinero, invirtiera una parte. [If I would have more money, I had invested part of it.]

exercises.sentence: Los precios están bajando poco a poco.
options: Prices are gradually falling.
Prices are rapidly rising.
Prices have not changed.

exercises.sentence: El producto es caro debido a la escasez.
options: The product is expensive due to the shortage.
The product is cheap because there is plenty.
The product is free.

exercises.sentence: Considero que la inflación afecta a muchas familias.

options: Ha aumentado porque hay mucha demanda. [It has increased because there is high demand.]
Ha aumentado por eso mucha demanda. [It has increased therefore high demand.]
Ha aumentado como consecuencia mucha demanda. [It has increased as a consequence high demand.]
Ahorraría una parte e invertiría otra. [I would save part and invest another.]
Ahorré una parte e invertí otra mañana. [I saved part and invested another tomorrow.]
Ahorraré una parte e invertiré otra ayer. [I will save part and invest another yesterday.]
Se observa que los precios están aumentando. [It can be observed that prices are increasing.]
Se observa que los precios aumentarían ayer. [It can be observed that prices would increase yesterday.]
Se observa que los precios aumentaron mañana. [It can be observed that prices increased tomorrow.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines trend, cause and consequence? [¿Cuál combina tendencia, causa y consecuencia?]
options: Los precios están aumentando porque hay mucha demanda; por eso, algunas familias gastan menos. [Prices are increasing because there is high demand; therefore, some families spend less.]
Los precios existen. [Prices exist.]
Hay un mercado. [There is a market.]

template.prompt: Explain a price change and its consequence.
template.answer: Los precios han subido porque hay poca oferta; por eso, algunas familias gastan menos.

template.prompt: Write a short hypothetical financial response.
template.answer: Si tuviera más dinero, ahorraría una parte e invertiría otra, pero no arriesgaría todos mis ahorros.
